title: orchis papilionacea subsp. grandiflora
intro: Orchis papilionacea subsp. grandiflora, commonly known as the butterfly orchid, is a subspecies of orchid that belongs to the Orchidaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues, digestive problems, and inflammation, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Orchis papilionacea subsp. grandiflora include bronchodilation, which can help alleviate symptoms of asthma and bronchitis, as well as its ability to stimulate digestion and improve appetite. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
